name: Brawler (Optimal Shenanigans Games)
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s brawler class levels gains the brawler‘s unarmed strike class feature. When determining the damage of the apprentice’s unarmed strikes, the apprentice’s effective brawler level is equal to half his apprentice level (minimum 1). At 3rd level the apprentice also gains the brawler’s flurry class feature. All of the apprentice’s attack rolls take a -2 penalty when using brawler’s flurry. An apprentice gains the 8th level Improved Two-Weapon Fighting improvement to brawler’s flurry at 11th level. The apprentice never gains the 15th level improvement to brawler’s flurry.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s brawler class levels and chooses brawler for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the brawler‘s martial flexibility class feature. When determining the uses per day, number of combat feats gained, and the action required to activate martial flexibility, the apprentice’s effective brawler level is equal to his apprentice level minus 3.

Cooperation Power

Key abilities: Strength or Dexterity

Apprentices who study a mentor’s brawler class levels and chooses brawler for their cooperation power may, as an immediate action, whenever they or an ally attempts a combat maneuver against an ally within reach, spend a cooperation point to grant a +2 bonus to that combat maneuver check.
